sarah.sales: Heads up — MerchantBank asked for a BYOK POC. They want a run-through of the key ceremony, rotation cadence, and a line-item for HSM ops on the quote. Can we get alignment before I send the SOW?

anna.solutions: Thanks — quick clarifying q's: is this fully cloud BYOK (customer uploads CMK) or do they want an HSM-backed CMK generated in the appliance? Also need number of custodians and region.

ben.eng: We support both: AWS CloudHSM import + our private HSM appliance for on-prem/air-gapped. For a POC we usually recommend: 3 custodians (2-of-3 threshold), single region (us-west2) to keep latency predictable. If they want HSM-generated CMK there is no key material export. Expect ~3–7ms added to encrypt/decrypt path for RPC.

mike.security: Security constraints from our side: rotation cadence acceptable is 90 days (customer-side preferred). Rotation window should be scheduled for low traffic (1h preferred). Cryptographic requirements: RSA-OAEP-256 or AES-GCM key-wrapping. We need HSM attestation certs and signed key policy from customer. Also we must ensure key material never leaves HSM in plaintext; escrow only by sealed blob.

anna.solutions: I can run the ceremony runbook. Proposed POC timeline:
- Day 0: Preflight (network, IAM, custodian list)
- Day 1: Remote key ceremony — custodians A/B/C generate or approve key shares on HSM
- Day 2: Import public thumbprints into Redwood private control plane + policy attach
- Day 3: Smoke tests (encrypt/decrypt, rotation dry-run)
We need ~10 business days lead time to provision a temporary appliance for the POC.

jenna.ps: Pricing notes for the quote draft: POC HSM appliance rental = "HSM-POC-Daily" add-on line (est. cost provided offline). One-time onboarding fee for BYOK key onboarding + runbook support. Technician day-rate if they want an on-site custodian. If they require multi-AZ replication or HC replication it's additional. I'll attach a sample ratecard to the quote.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: Wed 10:00 AM PT with MerchantBank (meeting-link.example.com) — organizer: sarah.sales

ben.eng: Implementation detail for rotation API (customer-initiated):
```
POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "rotation_mode": "customer-initiated",
  "scheduled_at": "2026-04-10T02:00:00Z"
}
```
We return a job id and rotation status. Optionally Redwood-managed rotation available (requires escrow agreement).

mike.security: Blocking / legal asks to flag: SOC2 + encryption appendix must reference BYOK controls. Legal will want DPA addendum for CMK lifecycle and eDiscovery constraints. Also confirm we record access logs to customer audit stream for 90 days.

sarah.sales: OK — next steps: @anna.solutions please share the runbook + required custodian checklist before EOD. @mike.security please confirm attestation artifacts we need so I can forward to their security contact. Jenna I'll need the draft quote line-items by tomorrow so I can push the SOW. :+1:

anna.solutions: On it — I'll drop runbook link and a shortened checklist (custodian contact + id + PGP/SSH pubkey) by EOD.

mike.security: I will upload the attestation rubric and cert requirements to the thread shortly.

sarah.sales: Nice, thanks team — I'll keep this thread as the single source for follow-ups.
